column2: Grid payloads transfer through fresh matches and moved subjects
nested tags release only the active byte owner
an owning enum local requires an explicit move into a match
a consumed subject reports its earlier match move
a payload constructor move consumes the original owner
a constructor cannot copy an owning payload
consuming a subject requires a statement match
a fixed array cannot copy owning enum elements
an inline optional unwrap transfers a C snapshot into the active payload
reusing an inline unwrapped optional reports the written move
